items.title: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) Courts Democrats Ahead Of 2026 Midterms Scrutiny
items.summary: Palantir Technologies (NasdaqGS:PLTR) is shifting political donations toward Democrats ahead of the 2026 US midterm elections after years of association with Trump aligned circles. The company is seeking broader ties in Washington as it prepares for possible changes in Congressional control and closer scrutiny of data and defense contractors.
